title: Maximum Path Quality of a Graph
goal: Maximize unique node value along a walk that starts and ends at node zero within the time budget.
strategy: Backtrack feasible walks while counting each node value only on its first visit in the current walk. Shortest return distances prune moves that cannot get back to zero in time.
